run_inference: run inference on a benchmark system with a checkpoint and InferenceSettings to get energy, forces, and stress predictions
compare_results: compare candidate InferenceResult against a baseline InferenceResult to compute energy error, force MAE, and force max error
format_report_table: format a dict of benchmark results into a human-readable table with energy error, force MAE, QPS, and GPU memory columns
run_PerfCheckRunner: run a PerfCheckRunner benchmark that compares candidate inference settings against an fp64 baseline across default benchmark systems
load_baseline_cache: load cached baseline InferenceResult objects from a JSON cache file if the cache key matches the expected key
